description: This file defines the TransactionsScreen widget for a Flutter application. It displays a list of recent transactions, manages data loading via providers, and references categories and transaction models. It includes UI components such as SliverAppBar, SliverList, and interactions like navigation and asynchronous category metadata fetching.

classes.name: TransactionsScreen
classes.description: A Flutter widget that displays recent financial transactions, supports lazy loading and navigation to add or edit transactions.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for TransactionsScreen.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Triggers loading of recent transactions when dependencies change, ensuring data is loaded once.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the transactions list, including handling loading states, empty states, and rendering list items with category info fetched asynchronously.
